mentions.name: crazyflie-commander
mentions.description: A terminal user interface (TUI) for controlling a Crazyflie nano drone, built with Rust as a learning project that results in a drone flying around the living room.
mentions.source_excerpt: A TUI to control a crazyflie nano drone. This is mostly a rust learning project - but insanely fun because it leads to something flying through my living room.
mentions.author: wazHFsRy
